subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Control UI for Multi-Agent + Subagent Orchestration (Hierarchy, Bulk Ops, and Scalability)

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated runtime subagent orchestration surface, expand Sessions, or route this through Workboard/Tasks?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent UI surface and bulk-operation safety model are product decisions that code inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Stage Read-Only Hierarchy First
options.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without privileged bulk actions, then review bulk controls separately.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Or Workboard
options.body: Keep the feature within an existing page to avoid a new top-level surface, accepting tighter constraints from that page's current model.

options.title: Defer Or Keep External
options.body: Decline core UI work for now if maintainers view this as a heavy orchestration layer better handled outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Stage Read-Only Hierarchy First
recommendation.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without privileged bulk actions, then review bulk controls separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily product direction against VISION.md guardrails, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the project owner.
